title: Draugr converter file, contract version 1
description: What a converter writes for Draugr to import with format: draugr-converter. A converter reads another tool's output in a CI step and writes this file; Draugr reads the file and runs nothing. Every object refuses a key it does not define.

version.description: The contract version the file follows. Draugr refuses any version but the one it reads.

commit.description: The commit the source tool scanned, 7 to 64 hexadecimal characters. Draugr holds the file to the commit its run reads.

repository.description: The repository the source tool scanned, as a URL or a path. Required where the importing component has several repositories, and matched to one of them.

written.description: When the converter wrote the file, as an RFC 3339 time in UTC.

results.description: The findings, one per flaw the source tool reported. An empty list is a clean scan.

converter.description: The converter that wrote the file. Its name has to be the one the importing descriptor declares.

name.description: The converter's name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

source.description: The tool whose output the converter read, and the file it read.

tool.description: The tool's name, as findings name it.

version.description: The tool's version, where its output states one.

file.description: The file the converter read, as the CI step named it.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of that file, in lowercase hexadecimal.

result.description: One finding. ruleId, message and severity are the finding as the tool reported it; package, cwe, labels, reachable and raise are Draugr's properties, which the importing descriptor's converter.sets has to list.

ruleId.description: The tool's id for the flaw, such as an advisory id.

message.description: What the tool said about the flaw, in one line.

severity.description: The tool's rating, in Draugr's words.

score.description: A CVSS-style score from 0 to 10, which decides the severity where present.

cwe.description: The CWE ids of the flaw, such as CWE-79. Needs cwe in converter.sets.

labels.description: Labels for the finding. A key the component's own labels set keeps the component's value. Needs labels in converter.sets.

reachable.description: A verdict that the project's code reaches the vulnerable code. Only true: no converter may say a finding is unreachable. Needs a package, and reachable in converter.sets.

location.description: Where the finding is, relative to the repository's root.

path.description: The file, relative to the repository's root.

package.description: The dependency the finding is about. Needs package in converter.sets.

name.description: The package as its ecosystem names it.

fixedVersion.description: The first version that fixes the flaw.

purl.description: The package URL, such as pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.20.

ecosystem.description: The package manager, such as npm or pip.

raise.description: A band the finding is ranked at least at. It never lowers one. Needs raise in converter.sets.

priority.description: The lowest band the finding may take.

reason.description: Why, as the report prints it.
